name: desk_gross_loss_limit_utilization_with_cap_and_buffer
question_template: A firm's daily loss limit is L={L} USD across four desks. Realized P&L today (losses negative): Desk 1 {P1} USD, Desk 2 {P2} USD, Desk 3 {P3} USD, Desk 4 {P4} USD. Rules: gains never offset losses on other desks for limit purposes; only desks with strictly negative P&L contribute. Gross loss is the sum of loss magnitudes of losing desks. Countable loss: cap each losing desk's magnitude at K={K} USD, sum the capped amounts, deduct the firm-wide buffer D={D} USD once, then floor at zero. Utilization is countable loss divided by L in percent, not capped at 100. Report the signed net P&L, gross loss, countable loss and utilization.

slots.description: Signed net P&L summed across all four desks, gains included
Sum of loss magnitudes of losing desks only, before cap and buffer
Per-desk capped losses summed, buffer deducted once, floored at zero

program:
def solve():
    pnls = [P["P1"], P["P2"], P["P3"], P["P4"]]
    K = P["K"]
    D = P["D"]
    L = P["L"]
    if L <= 0 or K <= 0 or D < 0:
        raise ValueError("limit and cap must be positive, buffer non-negative")
    net_pnl = sum(pnls)
    loss_mags = [-x for x in pnls if x < 0]
    gross_loss = sum(loss_mags)
    capped_sum = sum(min(m, K) for m in loss_mags)
    countable = capped_sum - D
    if countable < 0:
        countable = 0
    utilization = Fraction(countable * 100, L)
    return {
        "final": utilization,
        "net_pnl": net_pnl,
        "gross_loss": gross_loss,
        "countable_loss": countable,
    }
